progression.narrative: The performance opens on Dk4 and dwells most on C in Razavi. Forud (1:10.0) introduces Ab, Db, G, centred on C. The line peaks at Db5 (535.3 Hz) at 2:37.1. It closes on the tonic (Gk4 → Gk4 → G4 → C5 → C5 → G4).
